# Phase One Barber Shop

> Neighborhood barbershop based in Austin, Texas. A one-chair neighborhood barbershop at 6650 Manor Rd. Terry works fast, keeps the conversation going, and has regulars who have been sitting in his chair for almost ten years.

- Phone: (512) 662-1798
- Based in: Austin, TX
- Nearby areas: Austin, Windsor Park, Mueller, Northeast Austin, Manor, Pflugerville
- Google rating: 4.8 from 52 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/barbershops/texas/phase-one-barber/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/barbershops/texas/phase-one-barber/book.html

## Services
- Men's haircuts: The everyday cut for ages 13 and up. Walk in, take a seat, and leave looking right.
- Boys' haircuts: Cuts for boys 12 and under. Bring the kids in on a Saturday morning: the shop opens at 6 AM.
- College student cuts: Show a current student ID and get the college student cut on the shop's price list.
- Women's haircuts: Tapers and full cuts for women who want a clean, short style from a barber.
- Shaves: Head shaves with clippers or a razor, plus face shaves.
- Edge-ups, beards & mustaches: A quick edge-up between cuts, or a mustache or full beard cleaned up and shaped.

## About
Phase One Barber Shop is a one-chair neighborhood barbershop at 6650 Manor Rd in Northeast Austin. Look for the white-and-blue building with the checkered flag up top and the oval Phase One sign over the door. Terry runs the chair. Customers write about the same things again and again: walk-ins are welcome, he works fast, he does a great job, and there is never a dull moment. One regular has been coming to him for almost ten years. The shop is closed on Mondays and opens early the rest of the week, starting at 6 AM on Saturdays, so you can get a cut before the day gets going.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do you take walk-ins?
  A: Yes. Phase One is a one-chair shop and walk-ins are welcome. If a few people are ahead of you it still doesn't take long; one parent waited about 10 minutes early on a Saturday before her boys were in the chair.
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Tuesday to Thursday 9 AM to 6 PM, Friday 7:30 AM to 6 PM, Saturday 6 AM to 5 PM, Sunday 2 PM to 5 PM. Closed Monday. Holiday hours can change, so call (512) 662-1798 if you're not sure.
- Q: Do you cut kids' hair?
  A: Yes. Boys 12 and under have their own cut on the price list, and Saturday mornings are a good time to bring them in.
- Q: Is there a college student cut?
  A: Yes. The shop has a college student cut. Bring a current student ID.
- Q: Do you cut women's hair?
  A: Yes. Terry does women's tapers and full cuts.
- Q: Where is the shop?
  A: 6650 Manor Rd, Austin, TX 78723, in the white-and-blue building with the oval Phase One Barber Shop sign. The building is shared with Mobile One Lube.
